capabilities: Mention contacts anywhere in the vault with @ autocomplete
Maintain structured person notes with interaction logs
Track follow-up dates with hourly due/overdue reminders
Manage a deal pipeline kanban board (premium)
Generate AI follow-up suggestions from contact history (premium)
disambiguation: Not an integration or sync tool; 'Connect' refers to linking people to notes via @-mentions, not to outside apps.
extras: Freemium: free tier with no time limit or account; premium features via one-time license with a 14-day offline grace period. Not yet listed in the community plugin directory, so installation is manual or via BRAT. No telemetry; data stays in plain Markdown files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage people, record interaction history, or remind you of follow-ups across the notes you already write.

relations.evidence: Bring your own Anthropic or OpenAI key for next-action suggestions based on a contact's history.

requires.name: Premium license key from Lemon Squeezy

summary: Personal CRM that links contacts via @-mentions in notes, logs interactions, tracks follow-ups, and adds a premium deal pipeline with AI suggestions.
